summary.intent: Improve Cohezion's ability to model agents as Exotic Vacuum Objects (EVOs) by wiring FLUME VAE encoding and SurrealDB persistence into the Quadrature Nexus, then iteratively improving the system via Ouroboros anomaly detection and Mycelium skill synthesis — scaled overnight with specialist agent teams, test fixes, and compound engineering improvements.
summary.outcome: Implemented the full EVO closed-loop pipeline (E1–E62+), fixed the Mycelium additive calibration bug (E57), built 10+ new compound analytics modules (experiment_analytics, session_metrics_aggregator, compound_engine, health_monitor, etc.), reduced full-suite test failures from ~54 to ~38, and confirmed the convergence formula `consensus_n = 0.85 − 0.125 × (1−lr/2)^n` empirically across thousands of autoresearch runs.

repo: SurrealDB HTTP endpoint uses `RETURN true;` probe not `SELECT 1;` — SurrealQL doesn't support bare SELECT 1
SurrealDB SCHEMAFULL tables reject arbitrary subfields in object columns; use `option<string>` result field with JSON-encoded data as a workaround
SurrealDB datetime fields require `time::now()` not string literals like `'2026-05-01T21:00:00Z'`
autoresearch.jsonl uses `r['asi']['experiment']` not `r['experiment']` for the experiment label; `r['status']` not `r['verdict']` for keep/discard
The log_result() function has a 6-arg positional signature: `(run: int, metric: float, metrics: dict, status: str, description: str, experiment: str)`
conftest.py globally mocks sentence_transformers.SentenceTransformer as MagicMock to prevent AMD hardware segfaults — tests expecting real ST must use `@pytest.mark.skipif`
The Entire.io checkpoint daemon periodically resets the working tree to HEAD; use `git checkout HEAD -- <file>` to restore committed files after a reset
psutil mocks in tests need BOTH `psutil.virtual_memory` AND `psutil.cpu_percent` — mocking only memory leaves the CPU guardrail active and blocks tests on busy machines
FlumeVAE.forward() was updated to return 4 values `(recon, mu, log_var, z)` — callers using 3-value unpack break silently or with ValueError
CostAwareRouter expects `config/model_profiles.yaml` at repo root; missing file causes silent empty model list rather than an error

The Mycelium SET semantics bug: `apply_mycelium_feedback()` was using `_score_adjustments[vt] = adjustment` (SET), which each cycle replaces the previous calibration with a smaller value as observed mean rises — causing decay. Fixed to `_mycelium_calibration[vt] += adjustment` (additive accumulation)
run_llm_deliberation() unconditionally overwrites `_score_adjustments` on every call (line ~307); cross-cycle gains must go into `_mycelium_calibration` which is NOT reset per-deliberation

code.finding: apply_mycelium_feedback() now uses _mycelium_calibration[vt] += adjustment (additive) then exposes via _score_adjustments[vt] = _mycelium_calibration[vt]. The convergence formula is consensus_n = 0.85 − 0.125 × (1−lr/2)^n, max_error=0.00025
_detect_oscillation(vt) checks if last 3 entries in _mycelium_calibration_history alternate sign; fires when lr would overshoot — effective_lr is halved

connect() probes with RETURN true; not SELECT 1. HTTP headers must include surreal-ns and surreal-db. All CREATE statements need time::now() for datetime fields and metadata = {} for SCHEMAFULL tables

FlumeVAE supports dual-mode: FlumeVAE(input_dim=768, latent_dim=256) for legacy MLP and FlumeVAE(config=FlumeVAEConfig(...)) for token transformer. forward() always returns (recon, mu, log_var, z) — 4 values. reparameterize() returns mu deterministically in eval mode

ExecutionResult has compound_score: float = 0.0 field. Formula: compound_score = coherence × hiho_stability × skill_factor where hiho_stability = 1 - 2|coherence - 0.5|. Wired in execute_task() just before the return statement
_mock_psutil_resources autouse fixture must patch BOTH psutil.virtual_memory AND psutil.cpu_percent=25.0 or the CPU resource guardrail blocks tests on busy machines

Tests must patch httpx.AsyncClient not httpx.Client. Async methods (post, aclose) need AsyncMock not MagicMock. Content items need {type: text, text: ...} format (FastMCP protocol). vault_write_sync/read_sync/delete_sync are synchronous wrappers that use loop detection
vault_find_relevant_context() is async and must not be called without await in sync code. Use vault_search() sync wrapper instead
log_result signature: (run: int, metric: float, metrics: dict, status: 'keep'/'discard', description: str, experiment: str, **extra). run = int(time.time() * 1000)
check_precipitation() returns np.bool_ — must use explicit bool() cast or isinstance(np.True_, bool) returns False

FlumeTokenizer inherits mock __call__ when conftest mocks transformers globally. Guard: if 'input_ids' not in inputs, raise TokenizerOutputError — never return silent zero tensor (CLAUDE.md anti-pattern)
render_dashboard() added — human-readable compound session metrics with HIHO balance bar. record(label, delta, coherence) wired into overnight_evo_loop.py's log_result() for live HIHO tracking

download_dataset() now returns bytes (REST API). Use download_dataset_path() for Path-based kagglehub approach. Blocking kagglehub.competition_download() wrapped in asyncio.to_thread() for async safety

workflow: Surgical git commits: `git add <specific_files>` not `git add -A`; run `ruff format` + `ruff check --fix` manually before staging to prevent pre-commit hook conflicts
KAGGLE_GUARD_DISABLE=1 env var bypasses the branch guard for kaggle-related files on main branch
Pre-commit hooks that auto-format modify staged files and require re-staging before committing
autoresearch.jsonl must be untracked (`git rm --cached` + .gitignore) — it's a runtime log that causes LFS pointer/content conflicts in pre-commit stash/restore

The Entire.io checkpoint daemon creates an orphan branch with uncommitted changes periodically. All important work must be committed before checkpoints happen or use `git checkout HEAD -- <file>` to restore
TDD flow for compound engineering: write failing test first, verify RED, implement to GREEN, verify convergence formula empirically across N runs
When fixing OllamaEmbeddingProvider removal: the 'correct' fix is removing the patch entirely and using fallback_to_hash=True — the hash path is the proper abstraction boundary
AsyncMock vs MagicMock: any method that is awaited in production code requires AsyncMock in tests; MagicMock().method() returns a MagicMock that is not awaitable
V-model structural invariants using inspect.signature() catch API drift at ~1ms per test — worth adding for all public compound engineering APIs
Hardware-specific test failures (AMD GPU SIGSEGV, sentence_transformers) should use skipif markers, not xfail, since they're environment-dependent not expected failures

friction: Entire.io checkpoint daemon repeatedly reverted uncommitted working tree changes throughout the session, requiring constant `git checkout HEAD -- <file>` recovery

Pre-commit ruff-quick hook auto-fixes files mid-commit, requiring re-staging after each auto-format pass
The Mycelium calibration accumulation bug (E56) ran 4,786+ times before being caught — the retirement criterion was missing, and no stop condition existed for converged experiments
open_items: FlumeNav-v0 gymnasium environment is not registered — tests for RL trainer skip, product gap exists
test_adversarial_flood (test_resource_adversarial.py) has a pre-existing StopIteration/RuntimeError from MagicMock iterator exhaustion inside async BaseAgent — deeper fix required
JEPA world model (E46) achieves only ~0.97 final loss regardless of replay buffer — input distribution too uniform (single attractor) in heuristic mode; needs LLM mode with real score variance

The SurrealDB experiment_runs table was created but HTTP-direct writes were in a Gemini worktree that was cleaned up — experiment outcomes not yet systematically persisted to SurrealDB
